mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sku (shop_id, cate_name, sku_name, sell_point, stock, price, status, type, created_user_id, update_user_id) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{cateName}, #{skuName}, #{sellPoint}, #{stock}, #{price}, #{status}, #{type}, #{createdUserId}, #{updateUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sku SET status = 1, update_user_id = #{userId}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 0 AND stock > 0 AND price > 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_sku WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
